<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"List the roles assigned through a received grant"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/organizations/{org_id}/project-grants/{grant_id}/user-grants"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Requires `ORG_ADMIN` over this organization, which must be the
organization the grant was made **to**, or `PROJECT_GRANT_OWNER` of
this grant while it is active. The granting organization gets a 404
here: it lends the project, and does not administer the
receiving organization's people.

Listed under a revoked grant too, as history. A delegated role confers
nothing once its grant is revoked.

Paginated, oldest first: one grant to a large partner can carry every
one of its users.
